scope: Fresh production journey with observed combat contacts; real local API/Anvil transactions. No neutral unlock click, no injected playback, no screenshots. Causal telemetry does not prove physical onset or human listening.

receiptVerification.scope: Disposable Anvil receipt values and wallet history; no public latency claim

rehearsal.method: Fresh browser context, service workers blocked, HTTP cache disabled; CDP full encoded responses for requests begun before first battle (conservative upper bound); rAF cadence only while the visible boss battle renders, including stalls.
limitations: rAF measures browser rendering cadence; it is not a hardware display scanout measurement.
Local API and Anvil are isolated production-build test infrastructure. This does not prove public network or sponsor latency.

impact.scope: Observed fixed-timing contacts in these scenes only. Renderer submission and audio output timestamps are estimates, not measured photons or acoustic onset; unobserved units and skill modes remain open.

capture.method: Decoded frame sample count and timestamp span
